contexts.text: The Apostles' Creed referred to. TCR 81. TCR 175. TCR 636. Inv 30. Inv 31.

There are three Creeds, called the Apostolic, the Nicene, and the Athanasian, that specifically teach the Trinity; the Apostolic and Nicene, the Trinity itself; and the Athanasian, a Trinity of Persons... The Apostolic Creed was written after the time of the Apostles.
Trinity. 5. 1. The Apostolic Creed was written by the men who are called the Apostolic fathers.
